name: Blue Blue Noise
source:
"......I have no memory of what happened during the second year of high school," confessed the homeroom teacher, Seta Miyuki.

The outlaw high school student Sanada Akimoto is perplexed, but wishes to be close to his teacher.

Being chased away from home, he ends up living next door to him.

In an endless rain, Miyuki's past is gradually being revealed.

[translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/8432]Freem![/url]]
translation:
“……我不记得高中二年级发生过什么。”班主任濑田美雪坦白道。

不良高中生真田秋元对此感到困惑，却希望和老师更加亲近。

他被赶出家门后，最终住到了老师隔壁。

在无尽的雨中，美雪的过去逐渐浮出水面。
